description.value: Sheraton New York Times Square Hotel is a 51-story hotel located near Times Square. It sits on Seventh Avenue in Midtown, close to Broadway theaters, Rockefeller Center and Central Park. It is a large convention-style hotel with many room types for groups. Trip.com shows 7.8 / 10 Good 158 reviews. Representative Trip.com praise (guest reviews): “Room is great and clean”. Representative watch-outs: “The location is the only good thing about this hotel”.
